reason: Utilities version skew: the reference translation-server runs utilities 1dd38e27edf8, whose itemToCSLJSON/itemFromCSLJSON predate EDTF support; this port follows utilities 4051881d59c6 (kovan-common's port, the version #747 targets). Newer itemFromCSLJSON keeps a CSL date range as EDTF ('2010-03/2012-05', cslDateToEDTF, utilities_item.js:575); the old one formats only the first date ('March 2010').

Utilities version skew: the reference translation-server runs utilities 1dd38e27edf8, whose itemToCSLJSON/itemFromCSLJSON predate EDTF support; this port follows utilities 4051881d59c6 (kovan-common's port, the version #747 targets). Newer itemFromCSLJSON quotes a CSL literal date that would not export as the same literal (dateExportsAsLiteral: 'Spring 2021' parses to a year), :584-586; the old one stores it bare.
